free_text_notes.physician_note: 67-year-old man with hypertension, alcohol use disorder in remission, admitted 4/23 with aspiration pneumonia, improving. Oxygen weaned to room air yesterday.
free_text_notes.nursing_note: Up in chair for meals. Pain controlled. 4/28 12:00: Walgreens called: levofloxacin is out of stock until next week. No alternate pharmacy arranged. Discharge paperwork still waiting on the summary. A mild rash appeared briefly at the IV insertion site on day 2. It was assessed as a minor irritation, treated with a topical cream, and has fully resolved. The patient has a long-standing history of mild hearing loss that is managed with a hearing aid. They have their own hearing aid at home and this does not affect the discharge plan.
free_text_notes.case_manager_note: Plan is discharge home with sister.
